definition.question: How severed are cross-strait political relations and how intense is Beijing's coercive unification pressure?
definition.low_end: Functional cross-strait dialogue and communication channels exist with managed political differences and no coercive unification threats.
definition.high_end: Complete severance of cross-strait communication with Beijing openly threatening imminent forced unification and Taipei fully rejecting any engagement framework.

readings.rationale: No graded claims available to assess. Would be higher with evidence of suspension of semi-official channels, sweeping economic coercion, legal/political deadlines for unification, or escalatory rhetoric; lower with evidence of resumed dialogue, economic integration, or moderated political signaling. Research needed on CCP/Taiwan government statements, cross-strait channels, and coercive…
